items: Search, category filtering, cart and checkout

roles.can: Browse and search the menu. Adding to the cart asks them to log in.
Register, log in, fill a cart, place orders and follow each order's status.
Add, edit and delete products, change order status, and see customers and orders.

production: This version keeps everything in the browser, so it is a demo. For real customers, move users, products and orders to a server API with a database, hash passwords, and check roles on the server.
